requirement.value: Sensitive, Archivist or Rogue mastery + Soul Steal

system.description: After a successful Soul Steal: one target is Studied for free, immediately, using the Soul Steal Check's own Result and High Roll — no dice. And you deal +(SL in Soul Steal) damage to an elite or champion whose soul treasure you stole this scene. The sphere comes out and you learn what it was, one motion.
